title: Mens American-style Straight-leg Business-casual Trousers

Product information:
Product Overview:
These men's business casual straight-leg trousers are crafted from high-quality polyester fabric, offering a lightweight and breathable feel suitable for spring and autumn. The minimalist solid color design combined with a classic straight cut exudes an American premium aesthetic, making them an ideal choice for both commuting and daily leisure.

Style: Business Casual
Features: Straight leg, Zipper fly, Slight stretch, Thin thickness
Colour: Apricot, Black, Navy Blue, Army Green
Size Information:
Sizes: S, M, L, XL, XXL
Waist Type: Mid-rise
Closure: Zipper fly
Elasticity: Slight stretch
Thickness: Thin
Target Audience: Adults/Teenagers
Occasion: Casual/Commuting
